description: This Dart source file defines a mock chat service class used for offline, deterministic testing within a Flutter application. It implements the ChatService interface, providing methods for simulating chat interactions and generating mock responses based on user prompts. The class is designed to facilitate testing without network dependencies, mimicking an agent that processes messages and provides canned answers.

classes.name: MockChatService
classes.description: A deterministic, offline implementation of a chat service that simulates an AI agent's behavior for testing purposes. It returns predefined, consistent responses and mimics a multi-turn interaction in a controlled environment.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Simulates sending a message to the chat service, returning a mock response based on the current turn and message content. It models a two-step interaction: proposing a tool invocation and then providing a final answer.

methods.name: _extractTag
methods.description: Helper static method that extracts content wrapped in specific XML-like tags from a text string.

methods.name: _buildOfflineFinalAnswer
methods.description: Constructs a deterministic mock answer incorporating the user's question and last observation for testing purposes.
